t: The JSP EVO3 Safety Helmet offers robust head protection for demanding work environments. Constructed from durable HDPE, to provide all-day protection, making it ideal for construction sites, industrial settings, and general trade work. Features the Evolution 3D-Adjustment harness system and the Revolution Flex Wheel Ratchet, which eliminates pressure points to offer extreme comfort. 3D profile and extended nape section. Flexible strap contours to the head for a secure fit. Compatible with Sonis Ear Defenders and EVOGuard Visors.
b: Revolution Flex Wheel Ratchet Adjustment For Fast, Precise Fit
Enhanced All Day Comfort With Reduced Pressure Points
Compatible With JSP Hearing & Face Protection
